  <file path="src/i18n.ts">
    export const SIDENAV_LOCALES = ["en-US", "en-GB", "es-MX", "fr-CA"] as const;
    export type SideNavLocale = (typeof SIDENAV_LOCALES)[number];
    export type CatalogKey = keyof typeof EN;
    type Catalog = Readonly<Record<CatalogKey, string>>;
    export const CATALOGS: Readonly<Record<SideNavLocale, Catalog>> = {
      "en-US": EN,
      "en-GB": EN,
      "es-MX": ES_MX,
      "fr-CA": FR_CA,
    };
    export function resolveLocale(locale: string): SideNavLocale {
      return SIDENAV_LOCALES.find((known) => known === locale) ?? "en-US";
    }
    export function translate(
      locale: string,
      key: CatalogKey,
      params: Readonly<Record<string, string | number>> = {}
    ): string {
      return CATALOGS[resolveLocale(locale)][key].replace(
        /\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g,
        (placeholder, name: string) => (name in params ? String(params[name]) : placeholder)
      );
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/sections.ts">
    export const ACCOUNT_SECTION_ID = "Account";
    type Translate = (key: CatalogKey, params?: Readonly<Record<string, string | number>>) => string;
    function account(t: Translate): NavSection {
      return section({
        id: ACCOUNT_SECTION_ID,
        label: t("nav.sections.account"),
        items: [
          route("profile", t("nav.items.profile"), "/profile"),
          route("settings", t("nav.items.settings"), "/settings"),
          { id: "signout", label: t("nav.items.signOut"), action: { type: "signout" } },
        ],
      });
    }
    function admin(t: Translate): NavSection {
      return section({
        id: "Admin",
        label: t("nav.sections.admin"),
        items: [route("admin", t("nav.items.users"), "/admin")],
      });
    }
    function tools(t: Translate): NavSection {
      return section({
        id: "Tools",
        label: t("nav.sections.tools"),
        items: [{ id: "chat", label: t("nav.items.chat"), action: { type: "chat" } }],
      });
    }
    function setupSections(props: SideNavProps, t: Translate): readonly NavSection[] {
      const getStarted = section({
        id: "Get Started",
        label: t("nav.sections.getStarted"),
        items: [
          {
            ...route(SETUP_ITEM_ID, t("nav.items.venueSetup"), SETUP_PATH),
            badge: t("setup.count", { done: props.readiness.steps.length, total: SETUP_STEP_COUNT }),
          },
        ],
      });
      return props.flags.isAdmin ? [getStarted, account(t), admin(t)] : [getStarted, account(t)];
    }
    function operationalSections(props: SideNavProps, t: Translate): readonly NavSection[] {
      const primary = section({
        items: [
          route("briefing", t("nav.items.tonightsService"), "/briefing"),
          route("timeline", t("nav.items.timeline"), "/timeline"),
          route("reservations", t("nav.items.reservations"), "/reservations"),
          route("waitlist", t("nav.items.waitlist"), "/waitlist"),
          route("guests", t("nav.items.guests"), "/guests"),
          route("home", t("nav.items.dashboard"), "/dashboard"),
        ],
      });
      const manage = section({
        id: "Manage",
        label: t("nav.sections.manage"),
        items: [
          route("availability", t("nav.items.availability"), AVAILABILITY_PATH),
          route(SETUP_ITEM_ID, t("nav.items.venueSetup"), SETUP_PATH),
          route("menus", t("nav.items.menus"), "/menus"),
          route("booking-widget", t("nav.items.bookingWidget"), "/booking-widget"),
        ],
      });
      return props.flags.isAdmin
        ? [primary, manage, account(t), admin(t)]
        : [primary, manage, account(t)];
    }
    export function sections(props: SideNavProps): readonly NavSection[] {
      const t: Translate = (key, params) => translate(props.locale, key, params);
      const base =
        props.readiness.status === "operational"
          ? operationalSections(props, t)
          : setupSections(props, t);
      return freeze([...base, tools(t)]);
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/types.ts">
    export const SIDENAV_CONTRACT = 1;
    export type NavAction =
      | { readonly type: "route"; readonly path: string }
      | { readonly type: "chat" }
      | { readonly type: "signout" };
    export interface NavItem {
      readonly id: string;
      readonly label: string;
      readonly action: NavAction;
      /** Short status text after the label, e.g. the pre-launch progress count. */
      readonly badge?: string;
    }
    export interface NavSection {
      /** Locale-independent identity; collapse state is persisted under it. */
      readonly id?: string;
      readonly label?: string;
      readonly items: readonly NavItem[];
    }
    export const READINESS_STATUSES = ["loading", "no-venue", "setup", "operational"] as const;
    export type ReadinessStatus = (typeof READINESS_STATUSES)[number];
    export interface SideNavReadiness {
      readonly status: ReadinessStatus;
      /** Names of the launch steps already done; only the count is shown. */
      readonly steps: readonly string[];
    }
    export interface SideNavProps {
      readonly contract: number;
      /** The router-relative path, e.g. `/timeline`. */
      readonly pathname: string;
      /** A BCP 47 tag; unknown ones render en-US. */
      readonly locale: string;
      readonly direction: "ltr" | "rtl";
      readonly flags: {
        /** A display hint only. `RequireAdmin` and the API stay the enforcement. */
        readonly isAdmin: boolean;
      };
      readonly readiness: SideNavReadiness;
      /** Owned by hospitality; only affects screens narrower than 768px. */
      readonly isMobileOpen: boolean;
      readonly onAction: (action: NavAction) => void;
      readonly onMobileClose: () => void;
      /** Called once if the remote's root fails while rendering, so the host can swap to its fallback. */
      readonly onRenderError?: (error: Error) => void;
    }
    export interface SideNavSlots {
      readonly header: HTMLElement;
      readonly footer: HTMLElement;
    }
    export interface SideNavHandle {
      update(props: SideNavProps): void;
      slots(): SideNavSlots;
      unmount(): void;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/validate-props.ts">
    export class SideNavContractError extends Error {
      constructor(message: string) {
        super(message);
        this.name = "SideNavContractError";
      }
    }
    function fail(message: string): never {
      throw new SideNavContractError(message);
    }
    function checkKeys(where: string, value: Record<string, unknown>, allowed: ReadonlySet<string>) {
      for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
        if (TOKEN_KEY.test(key)) fail(`${where}.${key}: a token can not cross the seam`);
        if (!allowed.has(key)) fail(`${where}.${key}: not part of the contract (plain props only)`);
        if (isReactElement(value[key])) fail(`${where}.${key}: a React element can not cross the seam`);
      }
    }
    function checkString(where: string, value: unknown): string {
      if (typeof value !== "string") return fail(`${where}: expected a string`);
      if (JWT_SHAPE.test(value)) fail(`${where}: looks like a token, which can not cross the seam`);
      return value;
    }
    export function assertSideNavProps(value: unknown): asserts value is SideNavProps {
      if (!isRecord(value)) return fail("props: expected an object");
      checkKeys("props", value, TOP_LEVEL_KEYS);
    
      if (value["contract"] !== SIDENAV_CONTRACT) {
        fail(`contract: expected ${String(SIDENAV_CONTRACT)}, got ${String(value["contract"])}`);
      }
      checkString("pathname", value["pathname"]);
      checkString("locale", value["locale"]);
      if (value["direction"] !== "ltr" && value["direction"] !== "rtl") {
        fail("direction: expected ltr or rtl");
      }
    
      const flags = value["flags"];
      if (!isRecord(flags)) return fail("flags: expected an object");
      checkKeys("flags", flags, FLAG_KEYS);
      if (typeof flags["isAdmin"] !== "boolean") fail("flags.isAdmin: expected a boolean");
    
      const readiness = value["readiness"];
      if (!isRecord(readiness)) return fail("readiness: expected an object");
      checkKeys("readiness", readiness, READINESS_KEYS);
      const status = readiness["status"];
      const steps = readiness["steps"];
      if (!READINESS_STATUSES.some((known) => known === status)) {
        fail("readiness.status: not a known status");
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(steps) || !steps.every((step) => typeof step === "string")) {
        fail("readiness.steps: expected an array of strings");
      }
    
      if (typeof value["isMobileOpen"] !== "boolean") fail("isMobileOpen: expected a boolean");
      for (const callback of ["onAction", "onMobileClose"]) {
        if (typeof value[callback] !== "function") fail(`${callback}: expected a function`);
      }
      if (value["onRenderError"] !== undefined && typeof value["onRenderError"] !== "function") {
        fail("onRenderError: expected a function");
      }
    }
  </file>
  </section>
